subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should `openclaw agent --message-file` adopt the fixed 4 MiB compatibility limit for existing CLI automation?
rationale: The change intentionally turns previously unbounded accepted input into a documented rejection, so only the responsible owner can confirm that this upgrade behavior is the desired public CLI contract.

options.title: Accept the 4 MiB contract
options.body: Merge after final-head validation if the documented 4 MiB limit is the intended protection boundary for agent prompt files.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility policy
options.body: Revise the limit or introduce an explicitly approved alternative only if existing supported workloads require larger message-file input.

recommendation.title: Accept the 4 MiB contract
recommendation.body: Merge after final-head validation if the documented 4 MiB limit is the intended protection boundary for agent prompt files.

likelyOwner.reason: The final compatibility adjustment and assignment indicate direct ownership of the intended CLI behavior.
